passages.note: Aye on Senate third reading of SB1700 (16-12); the vote page prints the voter and tally but not the provision.

passages.provision_quote: If the department agrees with the parent's findings, the department shall add the book to the list described in subsection A of this section
passages.note: Removal follows a state department finding, not a committee of educators and parents, so rung 3 clause [b] fails.

rows.reasoning: SB1700 removes a book statewide only after the Department of Education reviews a parent's submission and agrees, which meets only the 'review finding before removal' side of 'Remove a challenged book only if a review committee of educators and parents finds it unsuitable'. The reviewer is a state agency rather than a committee of educators and parents, and the bill also orders exclusion of books by content test, so no rung is fully matched.
